Account-bound commands. Declare `--api-key` / `--api-url` on `mcpjam cloud` (before or after descendants). `mcpjam oauth login` is
MCP-server OAuth; `mcpjam cloud login` is your MCPJam account.

> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.
> Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with local results and an MCPJam identity
> The upcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest 0.3 releases require an MCPJam login or `sk_` API key for every eval, including BYOK runs
with uploads disabled. These versions must ship after the backend run-start endpoint is deployed. Earlier versions keep their exi
`mcpjam test <file>` runs an MCPJam suite file locally: it connects your MCP servers, drives each case's prompts through a model,
grades the transcript with the same assertions a hosted run uses, and decides the run with the same verdict policy. Bring your own
provider key and authenticate the run with MCPJam. With MCPJam-hosted inference it uses your existing CLI login and billing.
Results are **never uploaded**. The command writes results to your terminal and, if you ask, to a report file. It records the run
start with MCPJam. Like every command, it sends the CLI's single anonymous [telemetry](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemetry.md) e
